summary: The PlacementHistoryInstructor component is a web-based user control part of the HSPnet application, designed to manage and display the placement history of instructors. It allows users to view and manage instructor-related placement requests, generate reports, and control UI elements based on user permissions.
purpose: To manage and display instructor placement history, offering functionality for report generation and interface customization based on user access levels.

workflows.name: Page Pre-Render
steps: Check if the user session is active.
Retrieve staff details and display the instructor name.

workflows.name: Data Source Selecting
steps: Set input parameters for data retrieval based on user session and instructor details.

workflows.name: Print Command Click
steps: Generate PDF report if the user session is active.
Display the report in the HTML panel if report generation is successful.

business_rules: Report generation is only possible if the user session is active.
UI elements are adjusted based on user role and permissions.
validations: Check if user session is active before proceeding with report generation or data source access.
conditions: Visibility of certain UI elements depends on the user role and data properties like 'Archived'.
system_behavior: Renders instructor placement history details with options for sorting and report generation.
Dynamically manages visibility and styling of UI components based on data properties and user session state.
exceptions: If user session is null, cancel data source selection.
